collection.description: An elder remembers a lullaby that no one else knows, but several verses have slipped from memory.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (elder) remembers a lullaby that no one else knows, but several verses have slipped from memory.

choices.label: Invite Children to Help Reconstruct It
Make Room for a New Song

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Children invent a playful verse that (elder) loves.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) notices that the melody matches an old festival tune.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (visitor), a visitor, remembers a different ending and they compare versions.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: No one recalls the words, but they enjoy singing the surviving refrain together.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village records which lines are remembered and which are guesses.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (elder) is relieved not to be pressured to remember perfectly.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The family writes a gentle new verse alongside the old one.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (elder) prefers to leave the song unfinished as a reminder of change.
